visibleEditorialCopy.description: Directed by Kevin Costner, this frontier Western follows a former gunslinger forced to take up arms again after a corrupt lawman menaces his cattle crew.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A deliberate, suspenseful Western balancing moderate dramatic weight with steady frontier tension.
